tools.name: search_courts
tools.description: Search mapped tennis, pickleball and padel courts in a covered city or metro area, or around a point. Pass 'city' (e.g. 'Austin, TX', 'Lisbon', 'Los Angeles area'; add 'country' if the name is ambiguous) or 'lat'+'lon' (+'radius_km'). Optional filters: sport, setting (outdoor or indoor), lit, open_t

tools.name: get_court
tools.description: Get the details of one court venue by its id from search_courts: courts per sport, surface, lighting, access, fee, website, opening hours, OpenStreetMap links, source, data date and caveats.

tools.name: list_coverage
tools.description: List the covered cities and metro areas with the number of venues in each, grouped by country. It does not list courts: to find courts, call search_courts with city=<a name from this list>. Pass 'country' (e.g. 'Spain') to list one country; 'detail'=true adds per-city counts by sport (larger answer)
